name: Integrated Child Development Services
summary: An early childhood care and development programme delivered through Anganwadi centres, providing supplementary nutrition, immunisation, health check-ups, referral services and pre-school education to children below six years and to mothers.

eligibility_clauses.text: The child must be 6 years of age or younger.

entitlement_rules.text: Eligible children and mothers receive supplementary nutrition and pre-school services free of cost at the Anganwadi centre; there is no cash benefit.

appeal_hierarchy.description: First grievance at the centre level.
